title: Audit who gained access
hints: Turn both lists into sets with `set(...)`. That also removes the duplicates for free.
`after - before` is who was added, `before - after` who was removed, and `before & after` who was in both.
`old, new = set(before), set(after)` then `return {"added": sorted(new - old), "removed": sorted(old - new), "kept": sorted(old & new)}`
